scope: G3a authored route preflight; not an actual Nav2 path, traffic clearance or GPU qualification
override_scope: Single-robot clearance only; stations and the 19 physical obstacle footprints are preserved. These corridors do not permit two planning envelopes to pass side by side.

collision_radius.valid_for: G2 Nova Carter enabled collider union in the robot root frame; G3 GPU startup must remeasure the loaded asset

authored_allowances.scope: Conservative preflight assumptions; neither motor calibration nor a safety certification

closure.policy_input: current closed boolean only; no removal time
closure.scope: G3a checks the closed-state detour and barrier clearance; collider activation and observation require G3b

handover_contract: Retain occupied tiles. Replace a reservation atomically only after fresh estimated occupancy is contained in both predecessor and successor bundles. Denial preserves the predecessor. Parking occupancy is retained at run end.
